features.name: Copilot Studio agents for Business Central
features.description: A product that allows building conversational experiences and agents connected to Business Central data through Power Platform connectors and APIs.

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Business Central
features.description: An open protocol that allows AI systems to communicate with business applications in a standard way, serving as an alternative to Power Platform connectors for accessing Business Central APIs.

features.name: MCP Configurations page in Business Central
features.description: A new page in Business Central where users can define specific configurations exposing APIs with data in read-only mode for use with MCP servers and Copilot Studio.

features.name: Agent publication to multiple channels
features.description: Ability to publish Copilot Studio agents to different channels including Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot where the agent can be accessed and used.

features.name: Copilot Studio credit-based licensing
features.description: Copilot Studio requires purchasing credit packs or pay-as-you-go subscriptions based on usage. Users sharing the agent consume the credits but do not need additional paid user licenses.
caveats: not included in Business Central licensing
